content.short: Tender lets businesses accept crypto payments and settle in local currency in 17+ countries.
content.description: Tender is a crypto payment and settlement platform for businesses: merchants accept stablecoins such as USDT, move money across borders and settle in local currency, in more than 17 countries. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Tender.
content.meta: Tender lets merchants accept crypto and settle in local currency in 17+ countries, listed on Stable.
